events.content: Read PR 3125 review findings. Confirmed the guard must distinguish test-launched project HEAD mutations from concurrent external commits and must decode Git output as UTF-8 with replacement.
Implemented per-test GIT_REFLOG_ACTION attribution for successful porcelain commands and project-scoped GIT_TRACE2_EVENT attribution for successful update-ref and symbolic-ref writes.

Added Linux and Windows coverage for commits, branch switches, explicit git directories, failed plumbing commands, Windows executable names, malformed evidence, environment restoration, and real invalid UTF-8 Git output.

Verification: uv run pytest tests/ -x -q completed with 14336 passed, 21 skipped, and 45 xfailed. Focused Ruff, mypy, Python 3.10 syntax validation, actionlint, gh act validation, security scan, and git diff --check passed. Independent final review found no defects.
